# Apache Ossie model corpus

Every semantic model document found in [apache/ossie](https://github.com/apache/ossie) at commit 32c293c (examples and converter fixtures), converted from YAML to JSON unchanged. Used by `test/corpus.test.js` to check that RooQL loads real-world models or refuses them with a typed error.

These files are from the Apache Ossie project and are licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
